arabic text: (Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan)
english translation text: (Even today, the entire world weeps for Shabbir)

arabic text: Teen din ki pyaas me shabbir ka wo imtihaan\nSar zamine karbala roti thi roya aasmaan\nAaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan Aaj bhi shabbir ko
english translation text: Shabbir's trial through three days of thirst\nThe land of Karbala wept, and the heavens wept\nEven today, the entire world weeps for Shabbir Even today, for Shabbir

arabic text: Samne darya tha lekin tashnalab asgher raha\nKehti thi bali sakina hai labo par meri jaan\nAaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan Aaj bhi shabbir ko
english translation text: The river stood before him, yet Asghar remained thirsty\nLittle Sakina said: my life has reached my lips\nEven today, the entire world weeps for Shabbir Even today, for Shabbir

arabic text: Hazrate abbas ke bazu kalam jab hogaye\nKehti thi zainab saro se uth gaya hai sayebaan\nAaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan Aaj bhi shabbir ko
english translation text: When Hazrat Abbas's arms were severed\nZainab said: the shelter above our heads has been taken away\nEven today, the entire world weeps for Shabbir Even today, for Shabbir

arabic text: Sinaye akbar me barchi toot kar jab rehgayi\nKehte the imdaad ko jald aayiye ay baba jaan\nAaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan Aaj bhi shabbir ko
english translation text: When the spear broke and remained within Akbar's chest\nHe cried: Baba, come quickly to help me\nEven today, the entire world weeps for Shabbir Even today, for Shabbir

arabic text: Khoon me asgher naha kar sogaya maidan me\nDeyr tak rote rahe asgher pe sab teero kamaan\nAaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan Aaj bhi shabbir ko
english translation text: Asghar, bathed in blood, fell asleep in the battlefield\nFor a long time, even the arrows and bows wept over Asghar\nEven today, the entire world weeps for Shabbir Even today, for Shabbir

arabic text: (Jab sare shabbir zindaa(n) me sakina ko milaa) \nRoke dikhlane lagi rukh par tamaacho ke nishaan\nAaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan Aaj bhi shabbir ko
english translation text: When Sakina received Shabbir's head in the prison\nWeeping, she showed him the marks of slaps upon her face\nEven today, the entire world weeps for Shabbir Even today, for Shabbir

arabic text: Yaad ajaata tha akbar madare akbar ko phir\nJab kabhi kaano me aajati thi awaaze azaan\nAaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan Aaj bhi shabbir ko
english translation text: Akbar's mother remembered Akbar again\nWhenever the sound of the adhan reached her ears\nEven today, the entire world weeps for Shabbir Even today, for Shabbir
